normative_extracts.quote: The PerformanceObserver interface is used to observe performance measurement events and be notified of new performance entries as they are recorded.
Setting buffered: true includes entries that were recorded before the observer was constructed.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Subscribes asynchronously to browser performance timelines with buffered: true and flushes aggregated telemetry via navigator.sendBeacon on visibilitychange/pagehide.

production_failures.symptom: RUM dashboard reports 0% of LCP entries on fast pages
production_failures.root_cause: PerformanceObserver({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint' }) was registered after initial paint without buffered: true.
production_failures.mitigation: Always pass { type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true } when observing load-time metrics.

production_failures.symptom: Telemetry beacons abort on mobile tab switch or disable bfcache
production_failures.root_cause: Code flushed metrics in an unload listener using synchronous XHR or un-keepalive fetch().
production_failures.mitigation: Flush RUM payloads on visibilitychange (when hidden) or pagehide using navigator.sendBeacon() or fetch(..., { keepalive: true }).
